## Feature Request Context
Students want to cancel their attendance to a class themselves from the app. Coaches configure a cancellation deadline (default 24h, configurable in settings). Cancelling before the deadline frees the spot and triggers the existing smart-notification invitations. Late cancellations are allowed but flagged to the coach, not blocked. Coach gets a notification on every cancellation. No penalties/credits in this iteration.
